acceptanceCriteria: Runner identity comes from a kernel interface (sysctl KERN_PROC on Darwin, /proc on Linux) or the ps bound is justified by measurement; refusal semantics unchanged.
TestCALV0065_NativeFixture and the PSR probe tests pass 50/50 at load >= 40, with logs retained.
body:
Filed 2026-10-08 by the orchestrator from batch C (branch claude/batch-c-2026-10-07, base 0c94c66c).

V1-0989 (docs/build-log/2026-10-07-v1-0989-calv0065-flake.md, Remaining load-sensitive bounds) fixed the emptied-group proof with kernel ESRCH (CAL-V0-188), but poolRunnerIdentity still runs `ps -p PID -o lstart=` under a 1 s bound; at load 46-62 ps listings took 0.72-2.43 s, so health preparation can still fail spuriously. Part of the V1-0849 load-sensitivity umbrella. Also retained there: live-group listing tests (TestPSRBoundedProbes/actual-blocked-probe-process, TestPoolProcessDescendants) fail about 6/10 at load ~54 with or without the fix.
